name: handback-repo
description: Development tooling for the Handback extension and mod.

scripts.check: tsc -p extension && tsc -p extension/test && tsc -p plugin
scripts.plugin:check: node node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli-wrapper.cjs plugin validate . && node node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli-wrapper.cjs plugin validate plugin && node node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli-wrapper.cjs plugin test plugin
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run check && npm test && npm run plugin:check
